Fields marked 'uncertain' share lexical stems with consumer concepts (e.g., region, order, dump, note) but are not explicitly used; they are retained for safety pending validation. The compact schema trims extraneous attributes (unit_price_usd, notes, etc.) while preserving the minimal data needed for the stock check logic.
